📺 The Drop: A Snowfall Saga (2026–Present)

The Drop: A Snowfall Saga continues the world of Snowfall, following Wanda Bell and Leon Simmons as they attempt to rebuild their lives in 1990s Los Angeles. With the crack epidemic leaving lasting scars across their community, Wanda sets her sights on transforming West Coast rap into a powerful force in the music industry. As she works with ambitious young artists and navigates dangerous connections between record labels, street politics, and rival gangs, Leon struggles to leave his criminal past behind and create a better future. With familiar faces, new rivalries, and high-stakes decisions, the series explores ambition, loyalty, redemption, and the rise of West Coast hip-hop.

🎭 Genre: Crime • Drama • Music

⏱️ Runtime: 8 episodes in Season 1 • TV-MA

🎥 Creator: Malcolm Spellman

📅 Release Date: September 8, 2026

📺 Where to Watch: FX and Hulu in the United States. Disney+ internationally.

source_details.synopsis: The Drop: A Snowfall Saga is an American musical crime drama television series created by Malcolm Spellman for FX. A spin-off and sequel to Snowfall, it premiered on September 8, 2026, and follows Wanda Bell (Gail Bean) and Leon Simmons (Isaiah John), attempting to reinvent themselves in the West Coast hip hop scene of early 1990s Los Angeles. The series was put into development in 2023 as Snowfall concluded its six-season run, received a pilot order in March 2025, and was ordered to series by FX in November 2025. Its title was announced in June 2026. The first season consists of eight episodes, released weekly on FX and Hulu, with international distribution on Disney+.
